content: AJV is the JIT-compiled, fastest JSON Schema validator (7x+ faster than Zod) and the correct choice when JSON Schema is already the canonical schema format (as required by this project's gsd-core schema strategy). Zod/Valibot are TypeScript-first alternatives but require a second, parallel schema language - introducing them alongside JSON Schema creates schema-duplication/drift risk. @hookform/resolvers ships an official ajvResolver so react-hook-form can consume the same ajv schema/instance used for server-side pre-write validation.
